releaseNotes: Accurate MR Headquarters Stock Mapping: Fixed MR stock visibility so representatives automatically see their assigned HQ depot upon login
Multi-HQ Stock Switcher: Instant cross-HQ stock level chips and 1-tap switching between Kotma, Shahdol, Ambikapur, and Bilaspur depots in Stocklist and Today Tasks
Multi-Depot Support: Stock depot selector for HQs with multiple distribution centers
Admin HQ Assignment: Headquarters dropdown selector for registering and managing Field Representatives in the Admin Portal
Auto-Provisioning: Instant setup of primary HQ areas, stocker depots, and medicine catalogs for newly created Headquarters
Seamless In-Place Update: Release signing ensures smooth APK update without uninstalling or losing device credentials
